text: 晶华微：公司及控股股东吕汉泉于2026年11月2日收到中国证监会《立案告知书》，因涉嫌信息披露违法违规等被中国证监会立案。若后续经中国证监会行政处罚认定的事实触及重大违法强制退市情形，公司股票将被实施重大违法强制退市。
text_en: Jinghua Micro: The company and its controlling shareholder, Lü Hanquan, received the CSRC's "Notice of Case Filing" on November 2, 2026, and were placed under CSRC investigation on suspicion of information disclosure violations and other issues. If facts subsequently determined through CSRC administrative penalties trigger circumstances of mandatory delisting for major violations, the company's stock will be subject to mandatory delisting for major violations.
